name: Eliza Perlman
original_name: エリザ · パールマン
source:
Lieutenant of the Space Federation Army belonging to the New Solar faction.
Boasted unrivaled strength in cavalry battles on the planet Hermes.
She left Hermes with her promoted superior, Julia, and is currently working as an adjutant to a medium-sized battleship in the space around Jupiter.
Although she is a soldier, she is actually a child of the Pearlman family, a famous family who owns multiple military companies.

She is in loving marriage with an older male member of the unit, and now newly married for 3 months.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=922863&gc=gcl]Getchu[/url]]
